propositions: managed_refs marks refs as managed on local creation but cannot distinguish never-pushed local links from peer-deleted ones, creating a blind spot for inbound removal decisions

outbound_links._diff_links dedups ADDs direction-agnostically on (vendor_type, target_key) without relation deduplication, so local links with vendor-type collisions are never pushed and lack G4 outbound protection
inbound removal records for never-peer-confirmed managed links can reach the applier and incorrectly delete links the peer never carried

peer-confirmation state must be persisted durably (with Jira linkId, snapshot revision, and confirmation time) to enable _inbound_unlink_one to decline removals of links never confirmed by an authoritative peer snapshot

removal records must be honored only for links proven confirmed through outbound ADD success or observation in a fetched authoritative snapshot; partial/failed/stale reads cannot serve as deletion evidence
